name: Golem Slicing Axe

pages.text: When a metal golem kills other golems with this axe, all parts will be dropped and there is a chance for each of the upgrades to drop. Edit the target filter in config card to allow golems to attack other golems.

pages: When a metal golem kills certain mobs with this axe, one random metal golem part with matching material will drop:$(li)Vanilla: Iron Golem, Warden$(li)Cataclysm: Netherite Monstrosity, Ignis, Harbinger, Maledictus$(li)Mowzie's Mobs: Ferrous Wroughtnaut$(li)Legendary Monsters: Ancient Guardian, Cloud Golem
